title: VMware vSphere / VCF - Clusters
description: Selected cluster(s): status, capacity, ESX hosts (click a host to open it), resource pools, vSAN, alarms.

targets.expr: max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_hosts{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_hosts_effective{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vms_powered_on{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vms{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) ((vmware_cluster_cpu_demand_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} / vmware_cluster_cpu_effective_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) ((vmware_cluster_memory_demand_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} / vmware_cluster_memory_effective_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}))
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_ha_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_drs_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_drs_fully_automated{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_vsan_enabled{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_config_issues{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_datastores{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (vmware_cluster_drs_recommendations{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (increase(vmware_cluster_vmotions_total{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}[$__range]))

max by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (count by (vcenter, dc_name, cluster_name) (label_replace(vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="ClusterComputeResource"}, "cluster_name", "$1", "entity", "(.*)")))

panels.title: Usage if the largest host fails (N-1)
panels.description: Current ESX usage divided by the capacity left without the largest host. > 100% = the cluster cannot absorb a host failure.

targets.expr: sum by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}) / (sum by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_cpu_total_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}) - max by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_cpu_total_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}))

sum by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_memory_usage_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}) / (sum by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}) - max by (vcenter, cluster_name) (vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name", cluster_name!=""}))

panels.title: HA failover resources available / DRS score
panels.description: HA admission control (percentage policy) and DRS score (0-100). Only on real vCenters.

targets.expr: vmware_cluster_ha_failover_cpu_resources_percent{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}
vmware_cluster_ha_failover_memory_resources_percent{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}
vmware_cluster_drs_score{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}

max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) (vmware_host_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

max by (vcenter, cluster_name, host_name) ((vmware_host_memory_usage_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"} / vmware_host_memory_total_bytes{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}))

panels.title: Top 10 VMs by CPU ready (% per vCPU)

targets.expr: topk(10, ((vmware_vm_perf_cpu_ready_summation_seconds{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", perf_instance=""} / 20) / ignoring(perf_instance) vmware_vm_vcpus{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"}) and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})
topk(10, vmware_vm_cpu_usage_mhz{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name"} and on(vcenter, vm_moid) vmware_vm_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"})

panels.title: Alarms on the cluster and its hosts
Active alarms
panels.description: Active (triggered) vCenter alarms. Only present when an alarm is active.

targets.expr: (label_replace(vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="ClusterComputeResource"}, "cluster_name", "$1", "entity", "(.*)") and on(vcenter, cluster_name) vmware_cluster_overall_status{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}) or (vmware_alarm_triggered{vcenter=~"$vcenter", entity_type="HostSystem"} and on(vcenter, entity) label_replace(vmware_host_info{vcenter=~"$vcenter", dc_name=~"$dc_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster_name"}, "entity", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"))
